FontLab 8.2 delivers 250 improvements over FontLab 8.0, with major additions including
OpenType MATH table support, designspace-aware feature generation, smarter component
handling, and a redesigned Welcome screen.
It consolidates the FontLab 8 generation and sets the foundation for further free
updates.

consistent curves, comfortable spacing and kerning, technically solid font exports in
any format.

**FontLab 8.2** has 250 improvements over FontLab 8.0, 700 over FontLab 7, and 1,200
over FontLab VI. It’s easier to learn, better in every area, and faster.

Discover
[what’s new in 8.2](https://help.fontlab.com/fontlab/8/whats-new/release-notes/), then
[try FontLab 8 free](https://www.fontlab.com/font-editor/fontlab/#download) for 10 days.
